reason: The deposited MaxQuant table holds only HeLa runs of 0 to 500 cells; the B and T pools were searched with FragPipe and are not in it. The automatic label map read three empty wells in plate row B (0cell_B*) as B pools; without that misreading there is no B or T pool, so the test is void (protocol, PXD021882: 'If the table holds no B or no T pool, the test is void'; amendment 2).
statement: An internal held-out test, never external validation. Cell lines and tissue cells are outside the blood reference, and every set's acquisition differs from the reference's protein data.
